category_scope: Beauty & Personal Care (hair care, skin care, oral care); general rules where noted
how_brands_deliver_content: Two routes, both gated. (1) First-party suppliers: Tesco directs prospective UK suppliers to apply through RangeMe, and existing suppliers work through the Tesco Partners Toolkit (toolkit.tesco.com), a sign-in hub "for Suppliers, Marketplace Sellers and other Tesco partners". (2) Tesco Marketplace third-party sellers apply at toolkit.tesco.com/seller/apply-to-sell and then use the same toolkit (seller contact: the Tesco seller experience team). Product-content specifications are inside the toolkit and are not public. NIQ Brandbank shows the Tesco logo among its partners, which suggests a content-capture relationship, but no page retrieved today states that Tesco suppliers must deliver content through Brandbank.

languages.note: Not stated in the pages retrieved.

rules.requirement: Prospective UK product suppliers apply to Tesco through RangeMe; Republic of Ireland/Central Europe and clothing suppliers use the Tesco "Red Door" form.

Third-party sellers apply to sell on Tesco Marketplace through the Tesco Partners Toolkit application page; Tesco says it works with sellers who share its values on quality, trust and reliable customer service.

Tools and requirements for suppliers and marketplace sellers are held in the Tesco Partners Toolkit, which requires a partner sign-in (suppliers request access; marketplace sellers contact the seller experience team).

official_quality_signals.notes: No official content or listing-quality score is documented in the public pages that could be retrieved.

limitations: Tesco's product-content rules for both suppliers and Marketplace sellers are inside the login-gated Partners Toolkit; tesco.com pages refused automated access. Only the application routes were verified. The NIQ Brandbank link rests on a logo on a partner page, not on a stated requirement. No official content score was found. Web search was unavailable when this retailer was researched (shared search budget exhausted), so discovery relied on directly reachable official and content-partner pages.
